verdict.rationale: Granola's docs describe choosing a template, or creating your own, for specific call types such as 1:1s, interviews and sales pitches, applied during a call via the `/` menu. Recipes add saved, reusable prompts that run with one click. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of custom templates, and evidence that a template can be applied automatically by meeting type rather than picked manually each call.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can shape the notes with custom templates or saved prompts per meeting type (discovery call, 1:1, standup) instead of one generic format

citations.quote: While Granola's default summarisation adapts to a range of formats, you might want to choose a specific template (or set up your own!) for a specific type of call: for instance, 1:1s, interviews or sales pitches.
During a call, type `/` in your meeting notes to open the context menu and select a template.
Recipes are reusable prompt templates that help you quickly get insights from your meeting notes without typing the same questions repeatedly.
you can save your favorite prompts as recipes and run them with a single click.
